requirements.quote: An application protocol can assume that a QUIC implementation provides an interface that includes the operations described in this section.
requirements.condition: For a QUIC implementation exposing an interface to application protocols
requirements.required_behavior: Provide an interface that includes the stream operations described in this section.
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation interface can be inspected to determine whether the described stream operations are exposed.

requirements.quote: An implementation designed for use with a specific application protocol might provide only those operations that are used by that protocol.
requirements.condition: When the implementation is designed for use with one specific application protocol
requirements.required_behavior: The interface may be limited to the stream operations used by that protocol.
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation's declared target protocol and exposed stream operations can be compared with the operations that protocol uses.

requirements.quote: write data, understanding when stream flow control credit (Section 4.1) has successfully been reserved to send the written data;
requirements.condition: When an application protocol writes data on the sending part of a stream
requirements.required_behavior: Provide an indication of when stream flow-control credit has successfully been reserved for sending the written data.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can write stream data and verify that the interface reports successful reservation of the required stream flow-control credit.

requirements.quote: end the stream (clean termination), resulting in a STREAM frame (Section 19.8) with the FIN bit set;
requirements.condition: When an application protocol cleanly ends the sending part of a stream
requirements.required_behavior: Produce a STREAM frame with the FIN bit set.
requirements.why_checkable: Emitted frames can be inspected after clean stream termination to verify the frame type and FIN-bit value.

requirements.quote: reset the stream (abrupt termination), resulting in a RESET_STREAM frame (Section 19.4) if the stream was not already in a terminal state.
requirements.condition: When an application protocol resets a stream that is not already in a terminal state
requirements.why_checkable: A runtime test can reset a nonterminal stream and inspect transmitted frames for RESET_STREAM.

requirements.condition: On the receiving part of a stream
requirements.required_behavior: Provide an operation through which the application protocol can read data.
requirements.why_checkable: The receiving-stream interface can be inspected and exercised to verify that stream data can be read.

requirements.quote: abort reading of the stream and request closure, possibly resulting in a STOP_SENDING frame (Section 19.5).
requirements.condition: On the receiving part of a stream, when the application protocol chooses to stop reading and request closure
requirements.required_behavior: Provide an operation that aborts reading of the stream and requests closure.
requirements.why_checkable: The receiving-stream interface can be exercised to verify that the application can abort further reads and request stream closure.

requirements.quote: possibly resulting in a STOP_SENDING frame (Section 19.5).
requirements.condition: When the application protocol aborts reading of a stream and requests closure
requirements.why_checkable: The passage says STOP_SENDING is only a possible result and does not specify the circumstances in which the frame must or must not be emitted.

requirements.quote: An application protocol can also request to be informed of state changes on streams, including when the peer has opened or reset a stream, when a peer aborts reading on a stream, when new data is available, and when data can or cannot be written to the stream due to flow control.
requirements.condition: When the application protocol requests notification that the peer has opened a stream
requirements.required_behavior: Inform the application protocol that the peer opened the stream.
requirements.why_checkable: A peer can open a stream and a test can verify that the requested state-change notification is delivered.

requirements.quote: An application protocol can also request to be informed of state changes on streams, including when the peer has opened or reset a stream, when a peer aborts reading on a stream, when new data is available, and when data can or cannot be written to the stream due to flow control.
requirements.condition: When the application protocol requests notification that the peer has reset a stream
requirements.required_behavior: Inform the application protocol that the peer reset the stream.
requirements.why_checkable: A peer can reset a stream and a test can verify that the requested state-change notification is delivered.

requirements.quote: An application protocol can also request to be informed of state changes on streams, including when the peer has opened or reset a stream, when a peer aborts reading on a stream, when new data is available, and when data can or cannot be written to the stream due to flow control.
requirements.condition: When the application protocol requests notification that the peer has aborted reading on a stream
requirements.required_behavior: Inform the application protocol that the peer aborted reading on the stream.
requirements.why_checkable: A peer can abort reading and a test can verify that the requested state-change notification is delivered.

requirements.quote: An application protocol can also request to be informed of state changes on streams, including when the peer has opened or reset a stream, when a peer aborts reading on a stream, when new data is available, and when data can or cannot be written to the stream due to flow control.
requirements.condition: When the application protocol requests notification and new stream data becomes available
requirements.required_behavior: Inform the application protocol that new data is available.
requirements.why_checkable: A peer can make new data available and a test can verify that the requested availability notification is delivered.

requirements.quote: An application protocol can also request to be informed of state changes on streams, including when the peer has opened or reset a stream, when a peer aborts reading on a stream, when new data is available, and when data can or cannot be written to the stream due to flow control.
requirements.condition: When the application protocol requests notification and flow control changes whether data can be written to a stream
requirements.required_behavior: Inform the application protocol when data becomes writable or non-writable due to flow control.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can exhaust and restore flow-control credit and verify notifications for both loss and restoration of writability.
